subject: Commercial Grade Leaf Blower Ordinance
overview: The subcommittee reviewed a draft ordinance to regulate gas-powered leaf blowers, focusing on seasonal restrictions, noise levels, and enforcement logistics. The committee voted to refer the proposal favorably to the Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Preliminary Discussion and Public Comment
items.summary: Councilors and residents debated the health and noise impacts of gas-powered leaf blowers against the financial costs of transitioning to electric equipment and the potential burden on seniors.

items.title: Technical Review of Draft Ordinance
items.summary: The subcommittee conducted a line-by-line review of proposed language establishing seasonal usage windows, a 65-decibel noise limit, and operating hour restrictions for commercial operators.

items.title: Enforcement Capacity
items.summary: Building Commissioner Paul Mochi evaluated the city's ability to enforce the ordinance, noting that while additional staff is ideal, existing permit tracking software can manage neighbor complaints.

items.title: Committee Referral
items.summary: Referred the draft ordinance to the Committee of the Whole for further deliberation after the motion passed.
